lines.japanese:
「こんばんは。
お体の具合はどうですか、志貴さん」
　いつもの笑顔で、彼女はそう言った。
「あ……琥珀、さん」
　千切れた呼吸を束ねて、なんとか声をあげた。
「あ、喋らないでいいですよ。
今の志貴さんがどんな状態なのかは、きっと志貴さんより解っていますから」
　琥珀さんは笑顔のまま、俺の額に乗ったタオルを外した。
lines.label: s423
lines.maoEnglish:
“Good evening, Shiki. How are you feeling?”
she asks with her usual smile.
“Ah—Kohaku.”
I gather the torn scraps of my breath and somehow force out her name.
“You don’t have to speak. I believe I understand your condition far better than you do.”
Still smiling, Kohaku removes the towel from my forehead.

Still smiling, Kohaku removes the towel from my forehead.

"Good evening.

"Ah…… Kohaku, san."

"Ah, you do not have to speak.
I probably understand your condition better than you do."
She removes the towel from my forehead, still smiling.

lines.japanese:
―――やっぱり、さっきのは幻だったのか。
　琥珀さんはいつも通りだ。
こんな時でも笑顔のままで、翡翠のふりを続けている。
　……それを。
　俺は琥珀さんからその仮面を剥がす事もできず、ここで終わってしまうんだろうか。
lines.label: s423
lines.maoEnglish:
―――So what I saw before really was a hallucination.
Kohaku is as she always is. Even now she goes on smiling, goes on pretending to be Hisui.
That mask.
Will I end here without ever tearing it from her face?
lines.mao_english:
―――So what I saw before really was a hallucination.
Kohaku is as she always is. Even now she goes on smiling, goes on pretending to be Hisui.
That mask.
Will I end here without ever tearing it from her face?
lines.mirrorMoon:
---Was that thing before just an illusion?
Kohaku-san is acting normal.
She keeps smiling and continuing her portrayal of Hisui.
…… That.
Am I going to die here without being able to take off that mask?

lines.japanese:
「事情は秋葉さまから聞きました。
秋葉さまは明日まで待つ、とおっしゃっていましたが、それでは間にあいません。
　秋葉さまも冷静な判断力を失っているんですね。
　このままだと志貴さんは今夜を越す事はできませんから」
「―――――――――」
　ぜーぜーと喉が喘ぐ。
　琥珀さんの言葉は、容赦がなかった。
lines.label: s423
lines.maoEnglish:
“Miss Akiha told me what happened. She said she would wait until tomorrow, but then it will be too late.
Even Miss Akiha seems unable to think clearly.
At this rate, you will not survive the night.”
“―――――――――”
My throat rasps and wheezes.
Kohaku’s words show no mercy.
lines.mao_english:
“Miss Akiha told me what happened. She said she would wait until tomorrow, but then it will be too late.
Even Miss Akiha seems unable to think clearly.
At this rate, you will not survive the night.”
“―――――――――”
My throat rasps and wheezes.
Kohaku’s words show no mercy.
lines.mirrorMoon:
"Akiha-sama told me everything.
She said that she would wait until tomorrow, but that may be too long.
Akiha-sama seems to have lost her ability to think clearly.
I don't think you'll be able to make it through the night like that, Shiki-san."
"---------"
*wheeze* *wheeze*
Kohaku-san's words are unmercifully true.

lines.japanese:
「志貴さんは前に言いました。
自分は死というものに対して麻痺しているんだって。
　今もそうなんですか？
　だからこんな体でも秋葉さまに逆らうなんて、そんな希望のない事をしているんですか」
「―――――――――琥珀さん？」
　……驚いた。
　琥珀さんの声は、今までとは違う。
lines.label: s423
lines.maoEnglish:
“Shiki, you told me something once. You said you had grown numb to death.
Is that still true? Is that why you would defy Miss Akiha even in this condition, when there is no hope in doing so?”
“―――――――――Kohaku?”
I am taken aback.
Her voice is nothing like it was before.
lines.mao_english:

I am taken aback.

lines.mirrorMoon:

…… I'm surprised.
Kohaku-san's voice, it's completely different than before.

lines.japanese:
「……ワケないだろ。
俺は人より死ってものに敏感だって言ったじゃないか。
……だから、今の自分がどういう状況なのかは解ってるつもりだよ。
　琥珀さんに言われるまでもなく―――今夜を越すのは難しいなって、気づいてた」
「では、志貴さんは死が怖くないんですね。
秋葉さまを受け入れれば今すぐにでも良くなるのに、それをしないなんてどうかしています」
lines.label: s423
lines.maoEnglish:
“Of course I’m not numb to it. I told you I was more sensitive to death than most people. So I know exactly what condition I’m in.
I realized it before you said anything―――that I probably will not make it through tonight.”
“Then you are not afraid to die, Shiki. You could recover at once by accepting Miss Akiha; refusing her is madness.”
lines.mao_english:
“Of course I’m not numb to it. I told you I was more sensitive to death than most people. So I know exactly what condition I’m in.
I realized it before you said anything―――that I probably will not make it through tonight.”
“Then you are not afraid to die, Shiki. You could recover at once by accepting Miss Akiha; refusing her is madness.”
lines.mirrorMoon:
"…… No way.
I told you that I am more attuned to death than most people…… So I think I understand the situation I'm in.
Without you telling me---I knew that surviving the night will be extremely difficult."
"Then you are not scared of death?
If you accept Akiha-sama then you will recover quickly, but you still do not.
There's something wrong with you."

lines.japanese:
「……そうかもしれない。
けど、それでいいって思ってる。
俺はこういう自分が好きだし、そんな自分を好いてくれた秋葉が好きなんだ。
　……ああ、それに、さ。
こうして琥珀さんと話が出来るような、なんでもない事も好きなんだ。
　……だけど自分に嘘をついたら、そういうのが楽しくなくなりそうで、こわ、い――――」
lines.label: s423
lines.maoEnglish:
“Maybe it is. But I am all right with that. I like who I am, and I love Akiha because she loves me as I am.
And, yes, there is more. I love ordinary moments like this, lying here and talking to you.
But if I lied to myself, I’m afraid none of it would be fun anymore, and that scares me――――”
lines.mao_english:
“Maybe it is. But I am all right with that. I like who I am, and I love Akiha because she loves me as I am.

「志貴さん、わたし呆れてしまいました。

　それなのに秋葉さまに逆らうなんて、そんな希望のない事をしても仕方がないのに」

lines.maoEnglish:
“Shiki, I am appalled.
Do you truly not understand how precarious your body has become? All Miss Akiha has to do is wish it, and you will die.
There is no sense defying Miss Akiha when you have no hope of succeeding.”
“―――――――――Kohaku.”
I am taken aback.
Her voice is nothing like it was before.

I don't feel any more pain or dullness.

It hasn't gone through me completely, but I can feel my energy gradually increasing.
Soon I'll be able to move as I wish.
It's no use hurrying to Akiha's room, so until then---I want to quietly linger here with Kohaku-san.

“And the more I did, the more broken I became.
“I grew better at acting, better at lying, until I could deceive people with a smile. The harder I worked toward my purpose, the more thoroughly I lost the self I had tried to protect.
“What was happiness?
“What had sadness felt like?
“By then, I couldn’t even remember what pain meant.”

“I had finally become a doll and learned to endure pain, yet watching him threatened to make me realize that was only a belief I had forced upon myself.”

　秋葉の能力は瞳に見えている映像の鮮明さに比例する。
　今が深夜で建物の中だから、俺を捕えようとする熱気の動きが遅い。
　これが日中で光があるのなら、秋葉の視線と熱気の速度はほぼ同一になるだろう。
　そうなればいくら視えていても切り殺す事で防ぐ、なんて事さえ間に合わない。
lines.label: s425
lines.maoEnglish:
She is probably right.
Akiha’s power is proportional to the clarity of the image in her eyes.
Because it is midnight and we are inside, the heat that tries to seize me moves slowly.
In daylight, Akiha’s gaze and the heat would move at nearly the same speed.
Then, no matter how well I could see it, I would not have time even to defend myself by cutting it dead.
lines.mao_english:

Akiha’s power is proportional to the clarity of the image in her eyes.
Because it is midnight and we are inside, the heat that tries to seize me moves slowly.
In daylight, Akiha’s gaze and the heat would move at nearly the same speed.
Then, no matter how well I could see it, I would not have time even to defend myself by cutting it dead.
lines.mirrorMoon:
…… Well, that's probably right.
Her power works proportionally to the clearness of her vision.
Because we're in a building in the middle of the night, her fiery aura is slow in catching me.
If it was daytime, her vision and the fiery aura would probably be the same speed.
If that was the case, I wouldn't be able to kill that aura fast enough.

lines.japanese:
「くっ…………！」
　火傷だらけの足で後ろに引く。
　秋葉は追ってくる。
　お互い警戒しあっている為か、ただ間合いを維持したまま、俺たちは廊下を移動していく。
――――――その時。
　さっきまで俺たちがいた教室から、人影が、出てきた。
lines.label: s425
lines.maoEnglish:
“Damn…!”
I back away on my burned legs.
Akiha follows.
Perhaps because we are both wary, neither changes the distance between us as we move together down the corridor.
――――――At that moment.
A figure emerges from the classroom we have just left.

lines.mirrorMoon:
"Gg………!"
I pull back with the burning still in my legs.
Akiha follows.
Since we are cautious of each other, we keep our distance as we shift down the hallway.

A figure emerges from the classroom we were just in.

lines.japanese:
「―――――――」
　意識が止まる。
　頭痛も心音もしなくなった。
―――いけない。
　どうして出てくる。
どうしてあのまま気を失ったままで、教室にいてくれなかったのか。
「―――――秋葉、さま」
　背後からの声に秋葉が振り向く。
―――最悪だ、と直感した。
lines.label: s425
lines.maoEnglish:
“―――――――”
My mind stops.
The headache vanishes; so does the beating of my heart.
―――No.
Why has she come out? Why couldn’t she have remained unconscious inside that classroom?
“―――――Miss Akiha”
At the voice behind her, Akiha turns.
―――At once, I know the worst has happened.
lines.mao_english:

lines.mirrorMoon:
"-------"
My mind freezes.
My headache and my heartbeat disappear.
---This can't be happening.
Why did you come out?
Why couldn't you stay passed out in the classroom?
"-----Akiha, sama."
Akiha turns to face the voice behind her.
---I feel despair creeping all around me.

lines.japanese:
「もう、お止めください。
こんな事をしても、秋葉さまが苦しむだけです。
……人の血を吸い続けて、シキ様のように狂われても楽になれる事なんて、ないんです」
　よろよろと。
　今にも倒れそうな足取りで、琥珀さんは、秋葉へと歩いていく。
lines.label: s425
lines.maoEnglish:
“Please stop this, Miss Akiha. You will only make yourself suffer. Even if you keep drinking human blood until you go mad like Master SHIKI, it will never bring you peace.”
Staggering.
Barely able to remain on her feet, Kohaku walks toward Akiha.
lines.mao_english:

lines.mirrorMoon:
"Please stop.
If you do this, you will only hurt yourself, Akiha-sama…… Even if you keep drinking blood and go insane like SHIKI-sama, you will still suffer."
Swaying, wavering.
Like she will collapse at any moment, Kohaku-san walks towards Akiha.
lines.mirror_moon:

lines.japanese:
「――――――止めろ」
　呟きは届かない。
　琥珀さんの元に行くためには、秋葉をすり抜けなくてはいけない。
　そんな事―――どうやって、やれというんだ。
lines.label: s425
lines.maoEnglish:
“――――――Stop”
My whisper does not reach her.
To reach Kohaku, I would have to get past Akiha.
Something like that―――how could I possibly do it?
lines.mao_english:
“――――――Stop”

lines.mirrorMoon:
"------Stop!"
My outcry can't reach her.
To get to Kohaku-san, I have to go past Akiha.
How---can I do that?
lines.mirror_moon:
"------Stop!"

lines.japanese:
「……まだ秋葉さまは間に合います。
けれど志貴さんを手にかけてしまえば、本当に―――遠野よりの、鬼になってしまうんです」
「……………………………」
　秋葉は俺と琥珀さんを見比べる。
　そうして―――
「もう遅いわ。
私は血を吸う鬼なんだし、貴方の言葉にはもう踊らされない。
　楽にならない、ですって？
　この感覚を知らないくせに知った口をきかないでよ琥珀。
　私ね、今とても愉しいのよ。
シキの気持ちも解るわ。
こんなに自由で愉快なのは生まれて初めて。
　だから、今さら戻る事なんてできっこない」
lines.label: s425
lines.maoEnglish:
“……There is still time for Miss Akiha; but if you kill Shiki, then you truly will become―――a demon of the Tohno blood.”
“……………………………”
Akiha looks from Kohaku to me.
And then―――
“It is already too late. I’m a demon that drinks blood, and I won’t dance to your tune anymore.
“You claim this won’t bring me peace? Don’t pretend to understand a feeling you’ve never known, Kohaku.
“I am enjoying myself more than I ever have. I understand SHIKI now. Never in my life have I felt so free or had such fun.
“There can be no going back.”

And then―――
“It is already too late. I’m a demon that drinks blood, and I won’t dance to your tune anymore.

“I am enjoying myself more than I ever have. I understand SHIKI now. Never in my life have I felt so free or had such fun.
“There can be no going back.”
lines.mirrorMoon:
"…… You can still make it, Akiha-sama.
But if you kill Shiki-san, you really will---turn into a Tohno demon."
"…………………………"
Akiha looks at me and Kohaku-san.
And then---
"It's too late.
I already am a blood sucking demon.
I won't listen to what you have to say anymore.
Suffer?
You don't know anything about what I'm feeling so don't try and lecture me about it, Kohaku.
This feels wonderful.
I can understand what SHIKI was feeling.
This is the first time I've ever felt this kind of freedom.
So I can't go back now."

「違います……！
　秋葉さまはそう信じこもうとしているだけです。
シキ様を手にかけてしまわれて、志貴さんに全てを知られてしまって、それをなかった事にしたいのでしょう……？
　けど、それは出来ない事です。
どんなに狂われたフリをしても、秋葉さまは――――」
lines.label: s425
lines.maoEnglish:
“That isn’t true……! Miss Akiha is only trying to make herself believe it. You killed Master SHIKI, and Shiki learned everything, so you want to make it as though none of it ever happened—don’t you?
“But you cannot. However mad you pretend to be, Miss Akiha is――――”
lines.mao_english:
“That isn’t true……! Miss Akiha is only trying to make herself believe it. You killed Master SHIKI, and Shiki learned everything, so you want to make it as though none of it ever happened—don’t you?
“But you cannot. However mad you pretend to be, Miss Akiha is――――”
lines.mirrorMoon:
"You're wrong……!
That is only what you are telling yourself.
Isn't it just that you killed SHIKI-sama and Shiki-san found out about everything, so you want to make everything like it never happened……?
But that is something you cannot do.
No matter how crazy you may act, you're really----"

lines.japanese:
「うるさい…………！
　あなたなんかに、私と兄さんを殺しあわせようとしたあなたなんかに、そんな善人ぶった言葉を吐く資格なんかない……！」
　秋葉の髪が舞う。
　それは、俺に向けられた熱気とは質の違う、本当に質量をもった髪だった。
「ええ、満足でしょう琥珀。
あなたの思惑どおり私と兄さんは殺しあってしまっている。
あなたの復讐はこれで完成、というわけね」
「あ――――――――」
　琥珀さんの言葉が途切れる。
lines.label: s425
lines.maoEnglish:
“Be quiet…! You tried to make Brother and me kill each other; someone like you has no right to stand there pretending to be good!”
Akiha’s hair sweeps into the air.
This is not the bodiless heat she sent against me; this hair possesses real mass.
“You must be pleased, Kohaku. Brother and I are killing each other exactly as you planned. Your revenge is complete.”
“Ah――――――――”
Kohaku’s words die in her throat.

lines.mirrorMoon:
"Silence…………!
Don't try and act like a good person after setting us up to kill each other……!"
Akiha's hair dances in the air.
This is entirely different than the amount of power she directed against me.
"You must be satisfied.
Just like you planned, Nii-san and I are fighting to the death.
Your revenge is now complete, right?"
"Ah--------"
Kohaku-san's words are cut off.

　秋葉は勝ち誇ったように、俺に視線を向けてくる。
lines.label: s425
lines.maoEnglish:
“Of course you don’t know, Brother, do you? Kohaku manipulated you however she pleased until you lost all confidence in yourself.”
Akiha turns a triumphant gaze upon me.
lines.mao_english:
“Of course you don’t know, Brother, do you? Kohaku manipulated you however she pleased until you lost all confidence in yourself.”

lines.mirrorMoon:

「兄さんもおかしいとは思わなかった？
　毎晩すぐに眠くなって、自分の記憶が曖昧になったのは全部琥珀の仕業よ。
　琥珀はね、薬と偽って兄さんに麻薬めいた物を服用させていたの。
そうしてせん妄状態になった兄さんの耳元で囁いたんでしょうね。
『貴方は街で人を殺している殺人鬼です』って」
lines.label: s425
lines.maoEnglish:
“Didn’t you think it was strange, Brother? Growing sleepy at once every night, your memories becoming indistinct—all of it was Kohaku’s doing.
“She gave Brother something like a narcotic and called it medicine. Then, when Brother was delirious, she must have whispered into his ear.
‘You are a murderer roaming the city, killing people’”
lines.mao_english:

“She gave Brother something like a narcotic and called it medicine. Then, when Brother was delirious, she must have whispered into his ear.
‘You are a murderer roaming the city, killing people’”
lines.mirrorMoon:
"Didn't you think it was strange?
Going to sleep early every night, having your memories obscured, that was all Kohaku's doing.
She prepared you drugs instead of medicine.
And then all she had to do was whisper in your ear while you were high.
'You are the killer stalking the streets' was all she had to say."

「そうして琥珀は兄さんを殺人鬼にしたてあげて、私を殺させようとした。
　いえ、兄さんが殺人鬼になんかならなくても、兄さんが夜の街に出歩くようになるだけでも良かったのよ。
　どうなったって私と兄さんが殺しあってしまうような手の込んだ筋書きを作って、琥珀は笑顔でそれを実行していった。
　遠野家の人間に復讐するために、私だけでなく関係のない兄さんをも騙して、琥珀はこの状況を完成させたんだから」
lines.label: s425
lines.maoEnglish:
“That was how Kohaku made Brother into a murderer and tried to make him kill me.
“No—even if Brother never became a murderer, it would have been enough to make Brother walk the city at night.
“She devised an elaborate script that would make Brother and me kill each other whatever happened, then carried it out with a smile.
“To avenge herself on the Tohno family, Kohaku deceived not only me but Brother, who had nothing to do with it, and engineered everything you see tonight.”
lines.mao_english:
“That was how Kohaku made Brother into a murderer and tried to make him kill me.
“No—even if Brother never became a murderer, it would have been enough to make Brother walk the city at night.
“She devised an elaborate script that would make Brother and me kill each other whatever happened, then carried it out with a smile.
“To avenge herself on the Tohno family, Kohaku deceived not only me but Brother, who had nothing to do with it, and engineered everything you see tonight.”
lines.mirrorMoon:
"And after making you a killer, she tried to get you to kill me.

While she made this elaborate play pitting you and I against each other, Kohaku prepared everything with a smile.

　でも、それは。

lines.maoEnglish:
“…”
―――Ah, of course.
That was why Kohaku always appeared at precisely the right moment, told me what I wanted to know, and brought medicine whenever I could not sleep.
But that.

「琥珀にとって、私も兄さんもお芝居を完成させる為の駒にすぎなかった。

　琥珀にとっては兄さんだって、ただの道具にすぎなかった………！

Yes.

―――走った。

とす、という音。

呆然と。
いや、それとも受け入れるように、彼女は避ける事さえしなかった。
　倒れる。
　着物がゆれている。
なんていうスローモーション。
　それを認めたくない思考が、時間の流れを遅くしているのか。
lines.label: s425
lines.maoEnglish:
Akiha’s hair streams out behind her.
―――I run.
I strip away every useless thought—that approaching Akiha means death, that I can never make it in time—and run with my hand outstretched.
Yet some cruel part of me already understands.
From the moment she stepped out of that classroom.
My hand will never reach her.
A soft thud.
Sharp as a blade, Akiha’s hair pierces Kohaku’s chest.
Dazed. No—perhaps accepting it, she does not even try to evade the blow.
She falls.
Her kimono flutters. Everything moves so slowly.
Is my mind slowing time because it refuses to accept what it sees?

lines.japanese:
自身と敵との間合いを目測する。
　距離にして十メートル。
ナイフが届く範囲に跳びこむだけなら二足。
確実に仕留めるのなら三足が必要になる間合いだ。
　廊下には遮蔽物もなく、大きく動いて身を隠すほどの広さもない。
壁と天井を足場にした所で、秋葉の視界から外れる事は難しい。
　こちらが二足で踏み込んだところで、秋葉がこちらを視認するのが一息。
　状況は以上だ。
このまま間合いを詰めた所で、一呼吸の差でこちらが先に死ぬ事になる。
lines.label: s425
lines.maoEnglish:
I measure the distance between myself and the enemy.
Ten meters. Two steps to enter the knife’s reach. Three to kill with certainty.
The corridor offers no cover, no room to move wide enough to hide myself. Even if I use the walls and ceiling as footholds, escaping Akiha’s sight will be difficult.
Two steps for me to close the distance; one breath for Akiha to see me.
That is the whole situation. If I close the distance as things stand, that single breath will kill me first.

Even in this darkness, at that distance she can see me clearly.
One more step. The next time she advances, that will be the signal.
